results_note: All numerical results are author-reported; summaries are not independent reproductions.

papers.title: Scaling Online Exploration for Robot Agents
papers.summary_en: A frozen coding agent explores through robot APIs and turns perception, planning, and control into executable programs. Persistent notes and validated skills support reuse across episodes and tasks.
papers.summary_zh: 冻结编码代理通过机器人接口探索，将感知、规划与控制沉淀为可执行程序；以持久笔记和已验证技能支持跨回合、跨任务复用。

papers.title: When Plans Change, Remember: Replanning-Guided Visual Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.summary_en: Disagreement between adjacent action chunks about the same future time supplies a memory-write signal. A bounded visual memory stores key frames and filters duplicates. Memory is cleared at the start of each episode, so this is within-episode memory.
papers.summary_zh: 把相邻动作块对同一未来时刻的预测分歧作为记忆写入信号，用有限视觉槽位保存关键帧，并过滤重复画面。

papers.title: Embodiment-Classifier Guidance: Transferring Frozen VLAs Across Robot Dynamics without Demonstrations
papers.summary_en: An embodiment classifier is trained using successful rollouts from a small set of calibration tasks. Its gradients guide each π0 denoising step while the VLA stays frozen, connecting test-time action guidance with dynamics adaptation.
papers.summary_zh: 以少量校准任务的成功 rollout 训练具身分类器，在 π0 每一步去噪时用分类器梯度引导动作，保持 VLA 参数冻结。

papers.title: Spatial Memory by Agents, for Agents
papers.summary_en: A Designer Agent iterates memory construction and retrieval programs using feedback from a fixed Query Agent, then freezes the implementation for held-out observation histories. The tasks concern spatial/temporal questions, localization, and navigation queries, rather than continual manipulation-skill learning.
papers.summary_zh: Designer Agent 根据固定 Query Agent 的反馈迭代记忆构建和检索程序，再冻结实现，在留出的观测历史上评估。

papers.title: LAW: Unifying Language, Action, and World Modeling for Agentic Physical Intelligence
papers.summary_en: Semantic subtask progress connects VLM planning, state assessment, and world-action-model action generation, with hierarchical visual memory and subtask value learning.
papers.summary_zh: 以语义子任务进度连接 VLM 规划、状态判断与 WAM 动作生成，加入分层视觉记忆和子任务价值学习。

papers.title: AnchorQ: Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning for Policy Improvement via Flow-Reversed Action Anchors
papers.summary_en: Flow reversal maps rough reference actions to state-dependent noise anchors. Local particles and an online critic guide exploration while the base VLA remains frozen.
papers.summary_zh: 将粗参考动作通过 flow reversal 转成状态相关的噪声锚点，再以局部粒子和在线 critic 探索，保持基础 VLA 冻结。

papers.title: NestedVLA: Learning to Consolidate and Generate Skills for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.summary_en: Skills are trained separately and then a task-conditioned hypernetwork generates action-expert parameters, reducing conflicts from directly merging weights. This is a parameterized skill-consolidation approach.
papers.summary_zh: 先分别训练技能，再用任务条件超网络生成 action expert 参数，减少直接合并权重的冲突。

papers.title: ORD-WM: Learning Object-Centric Rigid Dynamics for 3D World Modeling in Robotic Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Rotation-equivariant latents encode object shape; predicted SE(3) transformations are applied analytically to preserve rigid geometry over multistep world-model rollouts.
papers.summary_zh: 用旋转等变潜变量编码物体形状，预测并解析施加 SE(3) 变化，使多步世界模型保持刚体几何。

papers.title: Beyond Success Rate: Interventional Evaluation of Memory in Vision-Language-Action Systems
papers.summary_en: Key-fact replacement, fact-preserving replacement, and numerical perturbation controls test whether robot systems causally use memory content, separating memory effects from general system sensitivity.
papers.summary_zh: 以关键事实替换、保事实替换和数值扰动对照，因果检验机器人是否真正使用记忆内容。

papers.title: Compile Once, Run Cheap: Frozen, Portable Skills for Embodied Agents, and What Recursive Self-Improvement Adds
papers.summary_en: A strong model writes, repairs, and freezes skills offline for execution by code or a cheaper model. The work studies executable experience, validation, inheritance, and deployment cost.
papers.summary_zh: 强模型离线编写、修补并冻结技能，再由纯代码或廉价模型执行。重点是可执行经验的积累、验证、继承与部署成本。

papers.title: Where is Physical RSI capability from? An Observational Scaling Law of LLM-as-policy
papers.summary_en: The study measures initial capability, improvement rate, success, and recovery separately over 18 RoboDojo tasks and up to 17 interaction rounds. History and workspace ablations probe which retained experience supports improvement.
papers.summary_zh: 18 个 RoboDojo 任务、最多 17 轮交互，将起始能力、改进速度、成功和恢复分开衡量；通过历史与工作区剥离对照分析经验积累来源。

papers.title: SARAM: Sparse Adapter Allocation with Reuse and Merging for Lifelong Robot Learning
papers.summary_en: SARAM reuses old LoRA adapters, sparsely allocates new ones, and penalizes redundancy. It identifies the task at each episode start and merges the selected adapter into the backbone, providing a parameterized lifelong-learning approach.
papers.summary_zh: 复用旧 LoRA、稀疏分配新适配器并惩罚重复；每回合先识别任务，再合并到骨干。为跨任务经验的参数化积累提供与显式技能库不同的对照。

papers.title: GPT-6 Astra Is a Native Visuo-Tactile Policy for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Tactile RGB images are supplied through a visual interface for contact-rich manipulation, together with few-shot demonstrations and interaction memory.
papers.summary_zh: 触觉 RGB 图像接入视觉接口，结合少样本演示与交互记忆做接触操作。

papers.title: SteerAct: Unlocking Action Models through Few-Shot Temporal Steering
papers.summary_en: A per-task bank of 24 success/failure-labeled rollouts supplies temporal feature references. Online steering chooses intervention timing, direction, and strength while π0.5/Fast-WAM stay frozen. It does not update the main model weights at test time.
papers.summary_zh: 用每任务 24 条带成败标签的 rollout 建立时序特征参考库，在线选择干预时机、方向和强度，冻结 π0.5／Fast-WAM。连接经验参考与测试时适应，不更新主模型权重。

papers.title: PICA-WAM: Visual Perturbation Invariance via Cross-Appearance Self-Alignment in World Action Models
papers.summary_en: An EMA teacher under normal appearance aligns shallow/deep action representations with a student receiving perturbed observations. No extra model is needed at inference.
papers.summary_zh: 正常外观的 EMA teacher 与扰动观测 student 对齐浅/深层动作表征，推理无额外模型，面向 WAM 后训练与真实环境外观鲁棒性。

papers.title: Self-Improving Video-to-Action Models
papers.summary_en: A video planner proposes goal videos, and a video-to-action model generates video/action training pairs through its own interactions and improves iteratively.
papers.summary_zh: 视频规划器提出目标视频，V2A 模型以自身交互生成视频—动作训练对并反复改进。

papers.title: TrajWAM: An Efficient Trajectory-Guided World Action Model for Dynamic Robotic Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Historical object masks predict trajectories; a Trajectory ControlNet guides future vision. Video distillation, adapter realignment, and action-rollout distillation preserve a one-step future-conditioned interface for dynamic manipulation.
papers.summary_zh: 由历史物体 mask 预测轨迹，用 Trajectory ControlNet 引导未来视觉，再通过视频蒸馏、适配器重对齐、动作 rollout 蒸馏保留一步未来条件接口，面向动态操作。

papers.title: LIBERO-Pro2.0: A Benchmark for Evaluating the Robustness of Embodied Foundation Models
papers.summary_en: The benchmark evaluates 17 policies, including VLAs and WAMs, using 22 static perturbation types, 20 runtime interventions, and 1,648 valid task variants. It probes feedback use, recovery, and combined perturbations.
papers.summary_zh: 22 类静态扰动、20 类运行时干预、1,648 个有效变体任务；17 种 VLA/WAM 等策略统一评估，覆盖反馈利用、失败恢复和组合扰动。

papers.title: LIBERO-Dynamic: Benchmarking Robotic Manipulation in Dynamic Environments
papers.summary_en: Forty LIBERO tasks receive three trajectory types at three speed levels, with physics advancing during inference according to measured latency. Six policies each face 1,800 dynamic conditions, supported by 9,000 dynamic demonstrations.
papers.summary_zh: 40 个 LIBERO 任务加入 3 类轨迹×3 档速度，推理期间按实测延迟推进物理；6 个策略每配置 1,800 个动态条件，9,000 条动态示范，面向预测、实时性与重规划的公平比较。

papers.title: DialogMem: Evaluating Dialogue-Grounded Embodied Memory in 3D Environments
papers.summary_en: RGB-D, poses, and human dialogue are written to memory for instance navigation and question answering across 142 episodes, 27 scanned scenes, and nine memory representations. The diagnostic separates grounding, retrieval, and action localization.
papers.summary_zh: 将 RGB-D／位姿／人类对话写入记忆，测试实例导航和问答；142 回合、27 个扫描场景、9 类记忆表征，分层诊断对象扎根、检索与行动定位。

papers.title: RoboValue: A Fine-Grained Sim-and-Real Benchmark for Unified Evaluation of Robotic Value Models
papers.summary_en: RoboValue evaluates robotic value models on task state, progress, failure recovery, and value consistency using 15 simulated and 20 real tasks, beyond binary success/failure classification.
papers.summary_zh: 15 个模拟和 20 个真实任务，从任务状态、进度、失败恢复和价值一致性评估 value model，超出成功/失败二分类。

papers.title: AgenticRoboRL: Bringing Coding-Agent Post-Training to Agentic Robotics
papers.summary_en: A 9B robotic planner improves through successful-trajectory SFT and multi-turn RL with a frozen executor. LIBERO-PRO reaches 71.0%, but tasks overlap between training and testing and no real-robot result is reported.
papers.summary_zh: 以成功轨迹 SFT 和多轮 RL 训练 9B 机器人规划器，保持执行器冻结；LIBERO-PRO 达 71.0%，但训练测试共享任务，且无真机结果。

papers.title: UniWALM: Unified World Action Language Model for Embodied Robot Control
papers.summary_en: Joint video, action, and language denoising feeds textual working memory back into control. Gains on memory tasks and 18 real-robot trials do not isolate memory from other components or establish cross-episode retrieval.
papers.summary_zh: 联合去噪视频、动作与语言，并将文字工作记忆反馈到控制；记忆任务和 18 次真机测试的提升未单独隔离记忆贡献，也未验证跨回合检索。

papers.title: EventSync: Event-Driven Memory Updates for History-Dependent Manipulation
papers.summary_en: An event monitor commits task history only after visual and motion evidence confirms completion. RoboMME reaches 64.5%, but the monitor needs event supervision and the comparisons reuse published baselines.
papers.summary_zh: 事件监控器在视觉和运动证据确认完成后才写入任务历史；RoboMME 达 64.5%，但需要事件监督，且对照沿用已发表基线。

papers.title: Plausible Future, Wrong Choice: Steering World-Action Models toward Intended Future
papers.summary_en: Task and causal-state tokens steer world-action predictions through visually ambiguous stages. StageBench rises from 40.9% to 69.4%; real-robot gains require task demonstrations and have small trial counts.
papers.summary_zh: 任务与因果状态 token 引导世界—动作预测，处理视觉相似阶段；StageBench 从 40.9% 升至 69.4%，真机提升仍依赖任务示范且测试样本较小。

papers.title: Physical Canvas: A Vision Tactile World Model For Robot Policy Evaluation And Learning
papers.summary_en: A vision-tactile world model supports evaluation and policy post-training. Mean real-robot success reaches 70.8% from a 59.1% SFT baseline on four ARX tasks, with one task below SFT.
papers.summary_zh: 视触觉世界模型支持评测与策略后训练；四项 ARX 任务真机均值从 SFT 的 59.1% 升至 70.8%，但其中一项任务低于 SFT。

papers.title: De-Diffusing WAMs: Action-Sufficient Direct Prediction for Robot Control
papers.summary_en: A frozen one-step action expert supervises direct future prediction through action error. DirectWAM achieves 97.1% on LIBERO and 85.4% on RoboTwin; the 28× speedup is model-side and teacher superiority is not established.
papers.summary_zh: 冻结单步动作专家，以动作误差监督直接未来预测；LIBERO 为 97.1%、RoboTwin 为 85.4%，28 倍为模型侧加速，未证明普遍超越 teacher。

papers.title: PACT-VLA: Speculative Action-Chunk Verification with Pre-Commit Observations
papers.summary_en: Newer pre-commit observations verify speculative action chunks from a frozen flow policy. Real-robot success rises from 60% to 82%, with added latency and no calibrated safety guarantee.
papers.summary_zh: 用较新的提交前观测验证冻结 flow 策略的候选动作块；真机成功率从 60% 升至 82%，同时增加延迟，且不提供校准的安全保证。

papers.title: Training Controllable World Models via Action Influence Maximization
papers.summary_en: Action-influence objectives guide active data collection for controllable world models. A Push-T controllability result yields an 85× data-volume ratio, with evidence limited to two simulated environments.
papers.summary_zh: 动作影响力目标引导可控世界模型的主动数据采集；Push-T 特定可控性指标对应 85 倍数据量比，证据仅覆盖两个仿真环境。

papers.title: AWLS: Advantage-Weighted Latent Steering for One-Step Generative Robotic Manipulation Policies
papers.summary_en: Advantage-weighted latent steering improves a frozen one-step decoder without post-training robot rollouts. AWLS achieves 65/100 real-robot successes; only its aggregate gain over MeanFlow survives multiple-comparison correction.
papers.summary_zh: 优势加权潜在引导在不进行后训练真机 rollout 的条件下改进冻结单步 decoder；真机成功 65/100，只有相对 MeanFlow 的总体提升通过多重比较校正。

papers.title: When Does Experience Memory Help Closed-Loop LLM Driving Agents? A Controlled Evaluation with Resampled Warmup Pools, Token-Matched Fillers, and Audited Baselines
papers.summary_en: Resampled experience pools and token-matched controls reveal fragile memory gains in a driving agent. Conclusions are limited to HighwayEnv, gpt-4o-mini, and 1 Hz, rather than all long-term memory.
papers.summary_zh: 重采样经验池与等 token 控制揭示驾驶 agent 的记忆收益不稳；结论限于 HighwayEnv、gpt-4o-mini 和 1 Hz，不能泛化到所有长期记忆。

papers.title: VLA-Retain: Benchmarking Cross-Dimension Effects of Vision Tuning in VLAs
papers.summary_en: A paired benchmark measures target gains and cross-dimension retention after VLA vision tuning. Non-target averages decline in 8 of 10 settings; the study concerns targeted fine-tuning rather than online continual learning.
papers.summary_zh: 成对评测 VLA 视觉调优的目标收益与跨维度保留；10 个设置中 8 个非目标均值下降，研究干预是定向微调而非在线持续学习。

papers.title: LaLa-World: Scaling Latent World Models with Natural Language Actions
papers.summary_en: Natural-language action representations unify latent world-model pretraining and joint action/future prediction. LIBERO reaches 97.7%; DROID action-prediction scores are not real-robot success rates.
papers.summary_zh: 自然语言动作表征统一潜在世界模型预训练及动作／未来联合预测；LIBERO 达 97.7%，DROID 动作预测评分不等于真机成功率。

papers.title: SPEM: Structure-Aware Procedural Memory for Efficient Skill Use in LLM Agents
papers.summary_en: Skill-DAG memory and state-conditioned Skill-GNN selection reuse successful skill compositions. ALFWorld reaches 87.1%, but the work does not establish new motor-skill acquisition or real-robot transfer.
papers.summary_zh: Skill-DAG 记忆与按状态选择的 Skill-GNN 复用成功技能组合；ALFWorld 达 87.1%，未验证新运动技能获取或真机迁移。

papers.title: More Memory, Worse Agents: Error Reproduction and Anti-Persistence in LLM Agents
papers.summary_en: Rebuilding and discarding task abstractions can reduce error reproduction while preserving raw experience. Three-seed ALFWorld gains are agent-specific and do not establish that all persistent memory is harmful.
papers.summary_zh: 保留原始经验、重建并丢弃任务抽象可减少错误复现；三种子的 ALFWorld 提升限于特定 agent，不能说明所有持久记忆有害。

papers.title: HexaShell: A Thin Harness for Exploring the Limits of VLM Agents as Robot Coding Agents
papers.summary_en: A substantive revision adds official hidden-seed evaluation on 42 RoboDojo tasks. The 46.9% success rate uses a different protocol from v1; released tools do not include the entire evaluation system.
papers.summary_zh: 实质修订新增 42 项 RoboDojo 任务的官方隐藏 seed 评测；46.9% 成功率与 v1 协议不同，公开工具不包含完整评测系统。

papers.title: DEFLECT: Temporal Counterfactual Preference Learning for Delay-Robust Asynchronous VLAs
papers.summary_en: The revision adds cross-backbone and continued-training controls for delay-robust VLA preference learning. GR00T reaches 73.10% at four-step delay, but protocol changes prevent direct headline comparisons to earlier versions.
papers.summary_zh: 修订为抗延迟 VLA 偏好学习补充跨骨干及继续训练对照；GR00T 在四步延迟下达 73.10%，协议变化使新旧版 headline 数字不可直接比较。

papers.title: WorldScape Policy 2.0: Empowering Steerable World Action Modeling with Reasoning-Augmented Memory and In-Context Learning
papers.summary_en: Corrected C2R ablations reduce the marginal long-term-memory gain from 3.42 to 0.67 percentage points. Architecture, main results, and real-robot results are unchanged, and the correction is unexplained.
papers.summary_zh: 更正后的 C2R 消融将长期记忆边际收益从 3.42 缩至 0.67 个百分点；架构、主表及真机结果未变，修改原因未说明。

papers.title: PrismWAM: Decoupling State Representations in World Action Models
papers.summary_en: Supplemental review of a 2026-10-20 announcement: RGB goals, depth futures, and actions are decoupled. Base RoboTwin C2R reaches 70.57%; real deployment requires RGB-D, and the 15B result uses additional pretraining.
papers.summary_zh: 补核 2026-10-20 公告：解耦 RGB 目标、深度未来与动作；基础版 RoboTwin C2R 为 70.57%，真机使用 RGB-D，15B 结果另有预训练。

papers.title: Plan First, Act Later: Streaming Reasoning for Executable Memory in Robot Control
papers.summary_en: Executable, episode-local memory improves RoboMME performance, but unequal seeds and frame sampling limit the Astra+VLA comparison; cross-task skill growth is unproven.
papers.summary_zh: 可执行回合内记忆提高了 RoboMME 成绩，但与 Astra+VLA 的种子数和抽帧不同，尚无跨任务技能扩展证据。

papers.title: From VLM Planners to Robotic Agents: Self-Evolving Harnesses for History-Dependent Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Offline harness revision raises RoboMME success from 44.38% to 51.38%; runtime context resets, and the reported repair does not establish new skill discovery.
papers.summary_zh: 离线修订 harness 将 RoboMME 成功率从 44.38% 提高到 51.38%；运行上下文重置，所述修复不构成新技能发现。

papers.title: CausGround: Causal Interaction Grounding for Adaptive Embodied Planning
papers.summary_en: An offline causal knowledge base improves planning, but RoboCasa uses replay-based high-level evaluation and the knowledge base does not grow during deployment.
papers.summary_zh: 离线因果知识库改善规划，但 RoboCasa 采用回放式高层评估，部署时知识库不增长。

papers.title: Asymmetric On-Policy Distillation Learns In-Context Exploration
papers.summary_en: Privileged on-policy distillation learns exploration across episodes sharing hidden conditions; real-robot samples are limited and context is not a permanent skill library.
papers.summary_zh: 特权专家的 on-policy 蒸馏支持共享隐变量下的跨回合探索，但真机样本有限，上下文并非永久技能库。

papers.title: inr2action: Encoding Robot Episodes as Neural Implicit Representations for Recall and Action
papers.summary_en: Episode videos are stored as INR weight deltas; QA improves over chance, but offline action regression does not establish closed-loop control or scalable retrieval.
papers.summary_zh: 用 INR 权重差存储回合视频，问答优于随机水平；离线动作回归尚不能证明闭环控制或可扩展检索。

papers.title: From Reasoning to Action: Benchmarking Frontier AI Models on LIBERO-10 Robot Manipulation Tasks
papers.summary_en: A tool-based LIBERO-10 benchmark measures frontier models without manipulation pretraining; a 44/100 versus 43/100 result is too close for a robust ranking.
papers.summary_zh: LIBERO-10 工具控制基准评估无操作预训练的前沿模型；44/100 与 43/100 的差距不足以形成可靠排名。

papers.title: Agentic World Action Models
papers.summary_en: Joint code–video–action denoising connects agent planning and control, but random-domain performance is weaker than π0.5 and the skill library remains frozen.
papers.summary_zh: 代码、视频与动作联合去噪连接 agent 规划和控制，但随机域成绩低于 π0.5，技能库仍冻结。

papers.title: PhysiCalWorld: In-Context Physics Calibration for World Models
papers.summary_en: A compact interaction-derived physics token improves several planning results without gradient updates, but simulation-only gains do not consistently beat all context or supervised baselines.
papers.summary_zh: 交互提取的紧凑物理 token 无需梯度更新即可改善部分规划结果，但仅有仿真证据，且并非始终优于上下文或有监督基线。

papers.title: CW-WAM: A Structured Contact-Wrench World Action Model for Force-Sensitive Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Contact-wrench history improves force-sensitive manipulation under matched ablations, but hand-set gains and larger contact forces prevent a general safety claim.
papers.summary_zh: 匹配消融支持接触力历史对力敏感操作的作用，但增益手设且部分接触力更大，不能概括为更安全。

papers.title: GeoMem-VLA: Internalizing 3D Scene Understanding into Temporal Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.summary_en: Training-only geometry supervision and temporal memory improve a shared VLA backbone; benchmark-specific adaptation and episode resets bound the generalization and memory claims.
papers.summary_zh: 仅训练时使用的几何监督与时序记忆改善了同底座 VLA；各基准专门适配且记忆逐回合清空，限制了泛化与记忆结论。

papers.title: Relational Geometry Forcing for World Action Models
papers.summary_en: Training-only relational geometry supervision improves WAM generalization, although LIBERO gains are small and the temporal term alone is harmful.
papers.summary_zh: 训练时关系几何监督改善 WAM 泛化，但 LIBERO 增益较小，时间项单独使用反而有害。

papers.title: How Representational Priors Shape Generalization in World Action Models
papers.summary_en: Representation geometry correlates with WAM robustness across backbones, but unmatched pretraining and architectures prevent a causal interpretation.
papers.summary_zh: 跨骨干的表征几何与 WAM 鲁棒性相关，但预训练和架构未完全匹配，不能作因果解释。

papers.title: DepState-JEPA: Learning Depth-Grounded State Representation for Visual Perception and Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Depth-grounded predictive representations transfer to matched real scenes, but fixed calibration, embodiment-specific training, and excluded search time limit transfer and speed claims.
papers.summary_zh: 深度约束预测表征可迁移到匹配的实机场景，但固定标定、本体专用训练及未计入的搜索时间限制了迁移与速度结论。

papers.title: T-WLA: Bridging Slow Vision and Fast Touch
papers.summary_en: A fast tactile editor corrects pending actions, but the no-touch variant nearly matches full performance, limiting how much gain can be attributed to touch.
papers.summary_zh: 快速触觉编辑器修正待执行动作，但无触觉版本已接近完整模型表现，限制了可归因于触觉的增益。

papers.title: Learning to Absorb Corrections: Critic-Weighted Residual Flow for Vision-Based Insertion
papers.summary_en: Critic-weighted residual learning is absorbed into ACT: residual-off success improves from 16% to 76%; cross-task forgetting and VLA transfer remain untested.
papers.summary_zh: critic 加权残差学习被 ACT 吸收：关闭残差后的成功率从 16% 提高到 76%，但跨任务遗忘和 VLA 迁移尚未验证。

papers.title: Training in Deployment: Human-in-the-loop Online Post-Training for Robot Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Human-in-the-loop deployment updates WAM checkpoints within a session; final performance is close to a budget-matched fixed policy and cross-task continual learning is untested.
papers.summary_zh: 人类参与部署使 WAM 能在会话内更新，但最终成绩接近预算匹配的固定策略，尚无跨任务持续学习证据。

papers.title: SimPT: An Automated Simulation Framework for Intervention-Based VLA Post-Training
papers.summary_en: Automated intervention collection enables controlled VLA post-training comparisons; real-robot gains transfer an algorithmic change, not a simulation policy zero-shot.
papers.summary_zh: 自动干预采集支持控变量的 VLA 后训练比较；真机提升体现算法改动迁移，并非仿真策略零样本转真机。

papers.title: Real2Sem2Real: 3D Semantic Augmentations for Robot Learning from a Single Human RGB Demonstration
papers.summary_en: Semantic 3D augmentation turns one human video into robot data with strong controlled gains, but teleoperation comparisons are unmatched and setup remains manual.
papers.summary_zh: 三维语义扩增将单个人类视频转为机器人数据，控变量实验增益明显，但与遥操作的比较不匹配，仍需人工设置。

papers.title: COWBOY: A Scalable Sim-to-Real Framework for Learning Contextual Whole-Body Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Local grasping experts support contextual whole-body manipulation, with strong real-robot results; compute is unmatched and the system does not learn continually in deployment.
papers.summary_zh: 局部抓取专家支持情境化全身操作，真机成绩较强；但算力未匹配，部署时不进行持续学习。

papers.title: AtomicRL: Atomic Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Atomic subtask credit assignment and bottleneck exploration improve long-horizon RL; the real-robot gain is 8.0 points over PPO, with training performed in reconstructed simulation.
papers.summary_zh: 原子子任务信用分配和瓶颈探索改善长程 RL；真机相对 PPO 提高 8.0 个百分点，训练在重建仿真中完成。

papers.title: ASPIRE: Agentic /Skills Discovery for Robotics
papers.summary_en: The revision adds real-robot cross-episode textual skill accumulation; per-rotation time improves, but total cube-solving time is not monotonic and human support remains.
papers.summary_zh: 修订新增真机跨回合文本技能积累；单次旋转耗时下降，但魔方总解题时间不单调下降，仍需人类支持。

papers.title: HarnessPAI: An Evolving Harness for Physical AI
papers.summary_en: New DreamZero fine-tuning reuses successful harness trajectories, raising the reported mean from 5.1% to 26.5%; evaluation-based checkpoint selection limits the evidence.
papers.summary_zh: 新增 DreamZero 微调复用 harness 成功轨迹，报告均值从 5.1% 提高到 26.5%；按评估成绩选 checkpoint 限制了证据强度。

papers.title: Feedback World Model Enables Precise Guidance of Diffusion Policy
papers.summary_en: Residual feedback adapts a frozen WAM without parameter updates; a moderate gain helps OOD success, while gain 1 worsens prediction errors.
papers.summary_zh: 残差反馈无需参数更新即可适配冻结 WAM；适中 gain 改善 OOD 成功率，而 gain 1 使预测误差恶化。

papers.title: SafeDojo: Safe Reinforcement Learning for VLA via Interactive World Model
papers.summary_en: The revision validates safety-head calibration rather than changing headline success results; small Level II gains and proxy costs do not establish real-world safety.
papers.summary_zh: 修订验证安全评估头校准，主成功率表未变；Level II 增益很小，代理成本不能保证真实部署安全。

papers.title: μ0: A Scalable 3D Interaction-Trace World Model
papers.summary_en: Version 3 exposes weak long-horizon completion and greater action-chunk latency than π0.5; unchanged atomic-task scores should not be mistaken for compositional progress.
papers.summary_zh: v3 揭示长程完成率低、动作块延迟高于 π0.5；原子任务主成绩未变，不能据此宣称组合能力进步。

papers.title: Externalise the Memory: A Pre-Registered Study of Where an Embodied Agent's Experience Should Live
papers.summary_en: A preregistered study compares LoRA consolidation with inference-time retrieval of visual episodic lessons. Its cleanest comparison toggles a frozen memory buffer while keeping policy weights fixed. The distillation null is underpowered, not evidence that parametric memory cannot work. Scope is narrow; retrieval combines text and images, and reset/logging defects require sensitivity analyses. The public repository is verified, but its claimed artifact release was absent when checked.
papers.summary_zh: 预注册对照研究比较将具身经验蒸馏进 LoRA 与推理时检索图文经历；核心实验在同一组权重上开关冻结记忆库。 蒸馏检验功效不足，不能证明经验无法写入权重；只测试窄任务及一种训练方案。图文贡献未分离，自动重置和日志缺陷虽有敏感性分析仍须注意。公开仓库已核实，论文所称制品 release 暂未查到。

papers.title: FastHarness: Experience-Driven Review Scheduling for Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.summary_en: FastHarness schedules GPT-6 Astra reviews of a frozen π0.5 policy using persistent stage and failure memory. Familiar execution skips reviews; risky states and recovery receive closer supervision without additional model training. The 80% comparison baseline is borrowed from another report, with five cases per task and a different scene mix, not a matched rerun. Episodes share memory and are not independent; the first tower episode already has prior experience. Savings are descriptive within-chain changes, not an end-to-end A/B effect. Evaluation is simulation-only and includes missed failures. The 57.2% is the mean of per-task percentage reductions, not the change in aggregate mean tokens. Token counts include input, output and cached inputs; they are not monetary costs.
papers.summary_zh: 固定π0.5，用持续阶段记忆安排GPT-6 Astra审核：熟悉阶段少审核，风险、历史失败与恢复阶段集中审核，无需训练新模型。 80%比较基线来自外部报告，每任务仅5例且场景混合不同，并非匹配重跑。共享记忆使回合不独立，搭塔首个评估回合已有经验；节省比例不是端到端A/B因果效应。仅仿真，且存在漏检失败。 57.2%是逐任务下降比例的均值，并非总平均token的下降比例；统计含输入、输出与缓存输入，不能等同费用下降。

papers.title: Know When to Escalate: Critic-Guided Adaptive Execution for Cloud-Local Embodied Agents
papers.summary_en: CARE uses a critic to transfer execution from a local model to a stronger cloud model, retains cloud control through recovery, and shares persistent handoff memory across executors. These are simulated decision-layer results, not physical robot response times. Local execution and criticism run on H200 GPUs. Thresholds are benchmark-tuned, and cloud-request ratios exclude critic calls. Network variability, sensing noise and hardware failures remain untested; no official code link was located. On EmbodiedBench, CARE remains below cloud-only success (75% versus 80%); the cloud-request ratio is not total compute cost.
papers.summary_zh: CARE 用评论器判断何时从本地执行器升级到云端，并保持云端接管直到恢复；双向共享交接记忆保留任务进度。 纯仿真决策层评估；本地模型和评论器使用H200，并非实测端侧机器人延迟。阈值按基准调节；云请求比例不包含评论器调用。无真实网络、传感或硬件故障验证。 EmbodiedBench上仍低于纯云端成功率（75%对80%）；云请求比例不等于总计算成本。

papers.title: Memory before Goal: Role of Pre-History Memory for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.summary_en: WholeBodyMem selects historical frames from SAM3 object events and supplies object spatiotemporal tokens and memory attention to a whole-body action expert. This is within-episode perceptual history, not cross-episode skill accumulation. Physical tests have only ten trials per task and no uniform-memory real-robot comparator. Missed SAM3 detections and tracking overhead remain limitations.
papers.summary_zh: WholeBodyMem 用 SAM3 对象事件选择历史关键帧，以对象时空 token 和独立记忆注意力向全身动作专家提供已经消失的线索。 这是回合内感知历史，不是跨回合技能积累；真机每任务仅10次且未给均匀记忆真机对照。SAM3漏检与跟踪成本仍是限制。

papers.title: Self-Distilling Future Video Representations for World Action Models
papers.summary_en: Observation history and EMA self-distillation improve future representations from one video-denoising pass for an action decoder. Appendices allow partial credit, so scores are not uniformly binary full-task success. Transfer instruction following is zero without human videos; cross-embodiment correspondence is implicit.
papers.summary_zh: 用观测历史与 EMA 教师自蒸馏，改善单次视频去噪产生的未来表征，再供动作解码器使用。 附录说明成功评分允许部分得分，不能都理解为完整成功率。未加入人类视频时，迁移指令遵循为 0%；跨具身对应是隐式学习。

papers.title: UniFlowWAM: A Unified World-Action Model with Visual Semantics and 4D Geometry
papers.summary_en: Three experts jointly model future vision, 3D scene flow and actions under ten objectives; deployment requires no flow input. 58.9% is the best evaluation seed; 87.7% uses the best evaluated checkpoint. Real policies are task-specific and starts remain within demonstration coverage; flow pseudo-labels are noisy.
papers.summary_zh: 将未来视觉、3D 场景流和动作放入三专家联合注意力模型，以 10 个目标联合训练；部署不需场景流输入。 58.9% 是最佳评估种子；87.7% 是最佳已评检查点。实机逐任务训练、初始条件在示范范围内；流伪标签有噪声。

papers.title: In-Context Learning World Models for Robot Dual-Arm Manipulation of Soft Garment with Partial Observations
papers.summary_en: Generative point-cloud completion feeds context-conditioned Transformer dynamics that rank flow-matching action proposals, without test-time weight updates. No real-robot policy comparator; success uses point-cloud-distance thresholds. PCN has better CD/EMD, whereas this method favors correspondence MSE. Dynamic motions and closed-loop replanning remain untested.
papers.summary_zh: 部分点云经生成式状态补全，再用上下文条件 Transformer 预测布料动力学，为流匹配动作候选排序；测试时不更新权重。 实机表无对照策略；成功由点云距离阈值定义。PCN 的 CD/EMD 更好；本文优势是对应点 MSE。快速动态操作及闭环重规划仍待验证。

papers.title: DeXplicit: Making Physical State Explicit in Dexterous Manipulation World Models
papers.summary_en: DeXplicit predicts object-centric motion and deformation in metric 3D before rendering action-conditioned video. Matched-input comparisons reduce long-horizon moved-point error 27–40% versus adapted PointWorld; explicit geometry improves object fidelity.
papers.summary_zh: DeXplicit 先在公制三维空间预测物体运动与形变，再渲染动作条件视频。在相同几何与动作输入下，长时域运动点误差较适配后的 PointWorld 降低 27–40%，显式几何也提高了物体保真度。

papers.title: DRILL: Training World Models to Improve Policies, Not Predict Pixels
papers.summary_en: DRILL trains a world model for the policy improvement its imagined rollouts produce. A cheaper visitation/advantage/confidence-weighted surrogate and a bilevel meta-gradient variant target downstream return instead of pixel fidelity.
papers.summary_zh: DRILL 直接优化世界模型生成的想象 rollout 对策略学习的帮助。其低成本加权代理目标与双层元梯度方案，把下游回报作为目标，而非仅追求像素预测精度。

papers.title: Skeleton-Grounded Latent Action Model for Robot World Models
papers.summary_en: Skeleton supervision separates kinematic and residual latent actions; swap reconstruction, branch dropout and an adapter enable action-conditioned video prediction. DROID prediction spans 0.8 seconds; valid-trajectory subsets differ. Human transfer comprises two generated-video examples. Policy evaluation has only nine real successes and cannot replace closed-loop validation.
papers.summary_zh: 骨架监督将潜动作拆成运动学与残差；交换重建、分支 dropout 和动作适配器支持可控视频预测。 DROID 预测跨度 0.8 秒；不同方法有效轨迹子集不完全相同。人→机器人仅两个生成视频例子。策略评估只有 9 次真实成功，不能代替闭环验证。

papers.title: When One Step Is Enough: An Empirical Study of Euler Integration in Flow-Matching Policies
papers.summary_en: Tests one Euler step using existing flow-matching checkpoints across six VLAs and a DiT, without additional one-step distillation. Similar aggregates do not establish per-task real-world equivalence: close-oven falls from 87% to 74%, and the physical evaluation cannot resolve its preregistered equivalence margins. Smaller models can degrade on long horizons; one-step RL updates are untested.
papers.summary_zh: 直接用既有流匹配策略做一次 Euler 推理，跨六个 VLA 和一个 DiT 检查是否必须多步采样；无需为单步额外蒸馏。 不能把总体接近等同真机逐任务等价：关烤箱87%→74%，真机预算不足以确认预设等价界限；较小模型长程任务会退化，也未验证单步 RL 更新。

papers.title: FocusVLA: Future-Intent Guided Dynamic View Routing for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.summary_en: Predicts future interaction intent from multimodal observations, state and action history to route global and wrist views in π0.5, using trajectory-derived weak labels. The real-robot gain is 13.3 percentage points. Cross-embodiment and diverse camera configurations remain untested; the added module requires training.
papers.summary_zh: 在π0.5上利用当前多模态输入、状态及动作历史预测未来交互意图，动态调节全局/腕部视角；用轨迹自动构造弱监督标签。 真机提升为13.3个百分点；跨本体和多种摄像头配置尚待验证。模块需训练，不是无需训练的推理期补丁。

papers.title: SmolVLA-MoE: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts for Efficient Multi-Task Robotic Manipulation
papers.summary_en: SmolVLA-MoE adds token-routed sparse FFN experts and a shared expert to the action module while freezing the VLM. It reports 84.25% mean LIBERO success versus 82.75% for dense SmolVLA, with about 500M activated and 800M stored parameters.
papers.summary_zh: SmolVLA-MoE 在动作模块中加入按 token 路由的稀疏 FFN 专家与共享专家，并冻结 VLM。LIBERO 平均成功率为 84.25%，对比稠密 SmolVLA 的 82.75%；约激活 5 亿参数、存储 8 亿参数。

papers.title: PiHand: Latent Hand-Object Interaction Priors for Physics-Based Policy Learning
papers.summary_en: PiHand distills simulated mocap-tracking experts into a goal-conditioned hand–object latent prior, then learns bounded residual exploration in that latent space. The same interaction prior supports new objects, trajectories, catching and bimanual handovers.
papers.summary_zh: PiHand 将仿真中的动作捕捉跟踪专家蒸馏为目标条件手–物交互潜变量先验，再在潜空间中学习有界残差探索。同一交互先验可支持新物体、新轨迹、接物和双手交接。

papers.title: Echo: Coupled Action and Task Status Signal Denoising for Vision Language Action Models
papers.summary_en: Echo jointly denoises actions plus stop/failure signals. Structured attention and faster signal denoising let cleaner status estimates guide action generation. Success, failure and recovery trajectories supply supervision without frame-level progress labels. Real-world scores are not success rates. Action supervision and training budgets are matched, but Echo receives extra failure-status data. Cross-method comparisons focus on flower insertion with adapted protocols; two tasks have no failed evaluation episodes. Benefits from higher-level stopping or replanning integration remain untested. The three-second outcome-window F1 does not imply instantaneous failure detection; simulation status accuracy covers ongoing/success frames under a specified window, not general three-class failure detection.
papers.summary_zh: 将停止与失败两种信号加入动作块，采用结构化注意力和更快的信号去噪，让较干净的状态预测反过来指导动作。训练使用成功、失败及恢复轨迹，无需逐帧进度标注。 真实评分并非成功率；动作监督及训练预算匹配，但Echo额外使用失败状态数据。跨方法比较集中于插花，部分采用适配协议；两任务无失败测试样本。高层自动终止/重规划收益尚未验证。 三秒结果窗口F1并非瞬时故障检测；仿真状态准确率针对指定窗口的进行中/成功帧，并非通用三分类失败检测。

papers.title: METTA: Memory-Enhanced Test-Time Adaptation for Meta-Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary_en: METTA separates fast gradient-updated within-episode neural memory from compact cross-episode summaries. It reports over 50% success on held-out Meta-World ML10/45 task families and better long-context sparse-reward exploration.
papers.summary_zh: METTA 将回合内可梯度更新的快速神经记忆与跨回合的紧凑摘要分开。它在 Meta-World ML10/45 未见任务族上报告超过 50% 成功率，并改善长上下文稀疏奖励探索。

papers.title: Asking Less, Adapting Better: Feedback-Efficient Test-Time Adaptation for Vision-and-Language Navigation
papers.summary_en: FETA makes test-time navigation updates from one binary feedback label on a selected action. It selects unstable trajectories, locates high entropy-gradient steps, and weights updates by policy–feedback disagreement.
papers.summary_zh: FETA 在测试时只对选中的关键动作索取一次二元反馈，并据此更新导航策略。它先筛选不稳定轨迹，再定位熵梯度大的决策步骤，按策略与反馈的分歧加权更新。

papers.title: Adaptive Aerial Loco-Manipulation Policy Learning via LLM-Assisted Proactive Task Generation
papers.summary_en: ALMA trains historical context with action-conditioned future-response prediction and uses LLM-generated arm-motion structures to expand RL training tasks based on failures. Deployment weights are fixed; adaptation is contextual, not test-time gradient training. Physical comparison is only against PID, so the 79.6% reduction is not relative to the strongest simulation baseline. Contact-force control remains future work.
papers.summary_zh: ALMA 用动作条件未来响应预测训练历史上下文，并让LLM依据失败生成新的机械臂运动结构，扩展RL训练任务。 部署参数冻结，适应来自上下文，非test-time梯度训练；真机只对比PID，不可将79.6%改善当作相对最强仿真基线。接触力控制仍属后续方向。

papers.title: Learning Robot Behavior Priors from Non-Robotic Synthetic Data
papers.summary_en: Pretrains a Transformer on procedural non-robotic MDP, contextual-bandit and linear-dynamical-system data, then predicts unseen robot actions from in-context examples. Evaluation is offline open-loop state-conditioned action prediction, not visual control or physical task success. “Zero-shot” still uses task-specific state-action examples as context.
papers.summary_zh: 用MDP、上下文bandit和线性动力系统等程序化非机器人数据预训练Transformer，通过示例上下文预测未见机器人动作。 仅离线开环动作预测，输入是状态而非视觉，不是真机执行成功率；“零样本”仍使用任务内状态动作上下文。

papers.title: Co^2Gen: Collaboratively Generating Task Plans for Decentralized Multi-Robot and Human Collaboration
papers.summary_en: Generates conditional collaborative programs with multi-agent planning, then converts executions into data for decentralized SmolVLA training. The strongest result depends on mixed human single-arm data, so the entire pipeline is not human-free. Generated data alone retains execution bottlenecks. Two tasks and limited trials do not establish general cross-embodiment transfer.
papers.summary_zh: 通过多智能体规划生成带条件检查的协作程序，将执行轨迹用于分散式SmolVLA训练；把程序级协作经验转成动作策略数据。 最强结论依赖混合人工单臂数据，不能说全流程无人工；自动生成数据单独训练仍有执行瓶颈。仅两任务和有限试次，尚非跨本体普遍结论。

papers.title: Progress Probes P²: Lightweight Runtime Monitoring for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.summary_en: P² learns a linear progress readout from π0.5 activations using successful demonstrations, then detects execution that lags nominal progress. It needs neither an external foundation-model monitor nor failure examples for training. Only π0.5 is tested; subtle spills can evade detection. The all-task hardware table reports a 0.78 average, but its displayed six values average 0.72, requiring aggregation clarification. Latency excludes VLA inference. No official code link was located. “Unseen” means unseen to the probe training, not necessarily to the underlying fine-tuned VLA.
papers.summary_zh: 仅用成功示范训练线性探针，从π0.5内部激活估计任务进度；执行落后于名义进度时报警，无需外部基础模型或失败训练样本。 仅测试π0.5，细微洒落可能漏检。PDF全任务硬件表声称平均0.78，但六项显示值算术均值为0.72，汇总口径需澄清。0.026毫秒不含VLA推理；未找到官方代码链接。 “未见”指探针训练未见，不一定是底层微调VLA未见。

papers.title: TEAR: Task-Evidence Authority Routing for Robotic Manipulation
papers.summary_en: TEAR combines network measurements, CLIP task cues and recent robot state in a causal temporal router that allocates authority between human teleoperation and local VLA control. Real trials were supervised: four manual switches occurred across two episodes. Evidence covers two related tasks and synthetic network impairment, with separately trained routers. Offline handoff F1 is 0.308 but recall only 0.286, below the rule baseline's 0.429. No official code link was located.
papers.summary_zh: 在机器人本地结合网络质量、CLIP任务语义与历史状态，用因果时序卷积预测稀疏交接事件，切换人类遥操作与本地VLA控制。 真实评估有人监督，两回合共含4次人工切换；不能称完全自动仲裁。仅两种相近搬运任务与合成网络扰动。离线交接F1为0.308、召回0.286，低于规则基线召回0.429。未找到代码链接。 两种设置分别训练路由器。

papers.title: Alpha: Systematic Fault Injection and Robustness Evaluation for LLM-Driven Embodied Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Injects faults at perception, actuation, kinematics and serialization boundaries, using a seed-matched scripted oracle to localize failures. Only one tabletop task and one model are tested, with five trials per fault-intensity cell. Realized perception lag saturates at 0.5s. Results do not establish general absence of reasoning deficits or real-robot safety.
papers.summary_zh: 在感知、执行、运动学与规划序列化边界注入故障，以匹配种子Oracle区分物理失败和规划接口失败。 只有一个桌面任务、一个模型，每故障强度5次；感知延迟实际均饱和0.5s。不能据此泛化“LLM没有推理缺陷”或实际机器人安全性。

papers.title: RGraph-Eval: Task-Grounded Scene Graphs for Evaluating Robot Video Generation
papers.summary_en: Temporal scene graphs compare generated/reference objects, relation changes and 3D paths; introduces the 1,000-scene ShareRobot-SG dataset. Correlation across only three generator means does not establish per-video reliability; object F1 trails SG-Ego. Single-reference/object assumptions and extraction errors can penalize valid alternatives; executable actions are not certified.
papers.summary_zh: 用统一时序场景图比较生成与参考视频的物体、关系变化和 3D 路径；引入 1,000 场景的 ShareRobot-SG。 小样本相关不能证明逐视频可靠性；物体 F1 不及 SG-Ego。单参考、单被操作物体和提取错误会惩罚有效替代方案；不认证动作可执行性。

papers.title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
papers.summary_en: A training-free CKNNA measure aligns sensory representations with DTW trajectory neighborhoods for offline policy/backbone screening. Real-robot r=.831 uses exploratory h=110; prespecified h=7 gives r=.429, p=.236. Correlation does not demonstrate training benefit or replace closed-loop testing.
papers.summary_zh: 无需训练，以 DTW 轨迹邻域与感知表征的 CKNNA 对齐，离线筛选策略及 VLM 骨干。 真实机器人 r=.831 使用探索性 h=110；预设 h=7 仅 r=.429、p=.236。相关不代表优化该指标会提高成功率；不能替代闭环测试。

papers.title: Beyond Imitation: Reinforcement Learning-Based Sim-Real Co-Training for VLA Models
papers.summary_en: RL-Co combines sim/real supervised warm-starting with simulator RL anchored by real-data supervision. The new revision adds a stronger rollout-distillation control and makes the limited real-world statistical protocol explicit.
papers.summary_zh: RL-Co 先用仿真与真机示范共同监督预热，再在仿真 RL 中保留真机监督约束。本次修订新增更强的 rollout 蒸馏对照，并明确真机统计评估的范围。

papers.title: Scale and Selection: What Makes Automatic Harness Evolution Work for Visual-Interface Robot Agents
papers.summary_en: Scale and Selection evolves a visual-interface robot-agent harness with rollout scaling and champion–challenger acceptance. The revision adds a distillation loop that transfers harness-assisted experience into a standalone robot policy.
papers.summary_zh: Scale and Selection 通过增加 rollout 样本量及优胜者–挑战者筛选改进视觉接口机器人代理。本次修订新增蒸馏闭环，将代理辅助执行经验转化为独立机器人策略。

papers.title: HEX: Humanoid-Aligned Experts for Cross-Embodiment Whole-Body Manipulation
papers.summary_en: HEX combines canonical body-part states, a mixture-of-experts proprioceptive predictor, compact visual history and flow-matching actions for humanoid whole-body manipulation. This revision adds two household long-horizon tasks, a ψ0 comparison, OOD pretraining tests and data-scaling/sensitivity experiments.
papers.summary_zh: HEX 结合标准化身体部位状态、混合专家本体状态预测器、紧凑视觉历史和流匹配动作，完成类人机器人全身操作。本次修订新增两个家庭长时域任务、ψ0 对照、分布外预训练测试及数据规模与超参数实验。

papers.title: FluxVLA Engine: A One-Stop VLA Engineering Platform for Embodied Intelligence
papers.summary_en: FluxVLA standardizes policy data, training, evaluation and robot execution. Its expanded revision adds an RLinf online PPO frontend, wider simulation/real-robot integrations and paired post-training evidence, rather than introducing a new base policy.
papers.summary_zh: FluxVLA 统一策略数据、训练、评估与机器人执行接口。本次大幅扩展的修订新增 RLinf 在线 PPO 接口、更广泛的仿真与真机集成，以及成对后训练实验；它是一套工程平台，而非新的基础策略。

papers.title: The Bitter Lesson Comes to Robotics
papers.summary_en: The Bitter Lesson Comes to Robotics compares frontier language models directly controlling physical YAM arms under a 40-action budget. The revision expands seven models/twelve settings to nine models/fifteen settings and updates the historical performance fit.
papers.summary_zh: 《The Bitter Lesson Comes to Robotics》比较前沿语言模型在 40 次动作预算下直接控制真机 YAM 机械臂的表现。本次修订把 7 个模型、12 种设置扩展到 9 个模型、15 种设置，并更新历史性能趋势拟合。

papers.title: FORCA: A Force-Aware Coding Agent for Contact-Rich Robot Manipulation
papers.summary_en: A coding agent uses RGB-D and wrist force/torque logs to generate and revise Python contact-probing and force-feedback programs. Experience is retained in executable control logic, without task-specific model training. Five real tasks, one model, small trial counts. Each development run permits 20 physical rollouts and four hours; humans authorize execution, reset scenes and judge final acceptance. The ablation changes access to force feedback and routines together, not just memory. Reasoning costs 4–10 minutes per iteration.
papers.summary_zh: 编码代理结合RGB-D与腕部力/力矩日志，生成并修订接触探测和力反馈Python程序；经验保存在可执行控制逻辑中，无需任务专属模型训练。 只有5项真机任务、单模型及少量试验；每次开发最多20个实体rollout和4小时，人类负责执行批准、场景操作及最终验收。对照同时移除力反馈和相关例程，并非单独隔离记忆贡献；每次推理耗时4–10分钟。

papers.title: RoboCode: Learning Reusable Action Primitives for Robot Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Learns a shared soft-compositional primitive codebook from pooled action chunks, then freezes its decoder and trains task-specific state-to-code encoders. Simulation only, with object poses/goals rather than image-language observations. Task-specific encoders are trained for the evaluated tasks; reusable codes are not evidence of online skill growth or unseen-task transfer. No multi-seed uncertainty or closed-loop trial count was established in the checked evaluation section.
papers.summary_zh: 先从多任务动作块学习可软组合的共享原语码本，再冻结解码接口，训练任务专属状态到码本编码器。 仅仿真，使用物体位姿/目标等状态而非图像语言输入；评估任务各自训练编码器，可复用码本不等于在线技能增长或未见任务迁移。已核评测部分未明确多种子不确定性及闭环试验次数。

papers.title: LogLook: Execution-Grounded Memory for Frontier-Model Robot Planners
papers.summary_en: Pairs an immutable execution log and verbatim note history with expectation-gated action frames and skim-then-inspect demonstrations. GPT-6 Astra plans either waypoints or grounded π0.5 subgoals; the memory is an inference-time interface, not parameter adaptation. The clean memory comparison demonstrates cost savings, not a clear success gain. Full-system gains also change action/call interfaces; direct control uses depth, calibration and task notes derived from success-checking code. One simulated benchmark and proprietary model, no real robot. Single-component failures differ by only 2–4 episodes.
papers.summary_zh: 结合不可改写的执行日志、逐字保留的笔记历史、预期变化触发帧及先粗看再细查示范；Astra输出路点或π0.5落地子目标。记忆是推理时接口，而非参数适配。 干净记忆对照主要证明降成本，未显示明确成功率增益；完整系统还改变动作/调用接口。直接控制使用深度、标定及来自成功判定代码的任务说明。仅单仿真基准和闭源模型，无真机；单组件消融差别仅2–4回合。

papers.title: Semantic Representation for Agentic Self-Play in Automated Laboratories
papers.summary_en: VERID maintains a persistent semantic laboratory twin with introspection, pre-execution simulation gates, synchronized traces and resumable state. Agents retain physical operating bounds and analytical lessons across runs. These are small case studies, not an isolated causal memory ablation: challenge instances and experimental strategies change. Uses a structured harness, internal Gemini checkpoint and operator approval gates in supervised runs. Biological discoveries and broad robot-policy transfer are not demonstrated.
papers.summary_zh: VERID提供持久语义实验室孪生，支持状态查询、执行前仿真门控、同步轨迹及故障续跑；代理跨运行保留物理操作边界和分析经验。 这是小规模案例而非隔离记忆因果效应的消融：挑战实例与实验策略同时变化。使用预设结构化Harness、内部Gemini检查点及受监督运行中的人工批准门控；未证明生物学突破或通用机器人策略迁移。

papers.title: RynnUnify: Towards Unified Embodied Brain
papers.summary_en: A Cosmos3-based 16B model couples an 8B reasoner and 8B video generator. Cross-chunk scene frames support interleaved visual planning; a separately RL-trained reasoner chooses whether to request generated evidence, and WAM adaptation adds joint video-action learning. Robot adaptation uses roughly 1,600 hours of atomic and 177 hours of composite RoboCasa data. Full-split baseline numbers are imported from reports, whereas Selected-20 is evaluated by the authors. Visual history is within-episode context, not demonstrated lifelong memory; three real tasks do not isolate memory’s contribution.
papers.summary_zh: 基于Cosmos3的16B模型耦合8B推理器和8B视频生成器；跨片段场景帧支撑交错视觉规划，另行RL训练的推理器选择是否调用生成证据，WAM适配联合学习视频与动作。 机器人适配使用约1,600小时原子任务及177小时组合任务数据。完整split的基线数值引用既有报告，精选20任务由作者评估；视觉历史是回合内上下文，不是已验证终身记忆，3项真机任务未隔离记忆贡献。

papers.title: FLORA: An Open Model Suite for Scaling Robotics Data Engines
papers.summary_en: An open labeling suite supplies temporal segments, intended-action captions and outcome/dense/rubric rewards for robotic data pipelines; segmentation/captioning use RL post-training, while the released reward model uses SFT. Not uniformly best across metrics; systems use different frame budgets/compute. The approximately 125× cost claim assumes GPU pricing and modeled throughput, omits deployment overhead, has unverified production GPU-hour accounting, and is not fully reference-version matched. No direct downstream policy-learning improvement is established here.
papers.summary_zh: 开放标注模型套件提供时序分段、动作意图描述及结果/稠密/规则奖励；分段与描述使用RL后训练，发布的奖励模型仅用SFT。 并非所有指标最优，各系统帧预算及算力不同。约125倍成本优势依赖假定GPU价格和建模吞吐，未含部署开销、生产GPU小时口径未核实，参考标注版本亦未完全匹配；这里未直接证明下游策略学习提升。

papers.title: KiRoSe: Using Kinematic Data for Efficient Segmentation of Robot Demonstrations
papers.summary_en: Compresses shared 14-D bimanual kinematics into transition-supervised Sparse Motion Tokens at two tokens/second; a LoRA-adapted language model predicts temporal segments and descriptions, with transfer to new robots and human hands. The encoder uses whole-episode normalization and symmetric temporal context, so it is offline. Tokenizer comparisons differ in input representation and reader-training populations, not just objective. Segmentation/semantic transfer does not establish closed-loop robot-policy gains.
papers.summary_zh: 把统一14维双臂运动学压缩为每秒2个、由转折边界监督的稀疏运动token，再用LoRA语言模型输出时间片段和描述，并测试新机器人及人手迁移。 编码器采用整回合标准化和对称时间上下文，因此是离线模型。tokenizer比较同时存在输入表示及reader训练样本差异，不仅改变目标函数；分段及语义迁移不等于闭环策略收益。

papers.title: Lifelong Context Adaptation through Bidirectional Memory-Skill Learning
papers.summary_en: MemCryst freezes the language model and co-evolves external episodic/factual memory and conditional skills. Repeated episodes support skill creation/revision; task outcomes adjust future retrieval weights without rewriting served records. Text-based simulation, not real robot control. Skill-only serving still retains internal memory for learning skills. Outcome credit is shared by all served records, not individual causal attribution; feedback noise and transfer to unseen domains are untested. Task order matters.
papers.summary_zh: MemCryst 冻结语言模型，使外部情景/事实记忆与条件技能双向演化：重复经历支持技能生成和修订，任务结果调整后续检索权重，不重写已服务记录。 这是文本仿真而非真机控制；“技能单独服务”仍保留用于技能学习的内部记忆。结果反馈分摊给全部服务记录，不是逐条因果归因；未检验错误反馈或未见领域迁移，任务顺序也影响结果。

papers.title: LeafSkill: Efficient Leaf-Level Action Grounding for Recursive LLM Agents
papers.summary_en: An external retrieve–bind–select layer reuses leaf-level action grounding while retaining the original recursive planner. A LoRA-trained 1.7B selector chooses an admissible bound action or defers to the unchanged host. Cost savings are conditional on common successes and concern host-model inference, not total system cost. Evidence covers one planner/host and two discrete-action simulations; ALFWorld success differences are not significant. Library growth demonstrates read-time adoption, not monotonic success improvement or continuous robot control.
papers.summary_zh: 外部检索–绑定–选择层复用叶级动作grounding，保留原递归规划器；经LoRA训练的1.7B选择器选出合法绑定动作，或交回未修改的上层模型。 成本节省以共同成功任务为条件，仅计上层模型而非完整系统成本。仅一个规划器/上层模型、两个离散动作仿真；ALFWorld成功率差异不显著。扩库证明读时采用新技能，不证明成功率单调增长或连续机器人控制。

papers.title: When to Stop Penalizing Actions? Martingale GRPO for VLA Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary_en: MART-GRPO uses a fine-tuned, then frozen VLM to locate the last visible unrecovered error in full rollout videos and truncate subsequent failure penalties, retaining successful-rollout terms and original normalization. Ideal stopping results motivate, but do not certify, the retrospective implementation. Simulation only. The actor sees one camera while the VLM reviews three; additional annotations and VLM fine-tuning are required. Boundaries use future rollout information and need not satisfy ideal stopping assumptions. One task declines by 1.95 points; held-out scene seeds are not independent training seeds.
papers.summary_zh: MART-GRPO 用微调后冻结的VLM从完整rollout视频定位最后一个未恢复的可见错误，截断其后失败惩罚，同时保留成功轨迹项及原归一化；理想停止理论提供动机，但不认证实际回溯实现。 仅仿真；策略看单相机，VLM审查三视角，另需标注及VLM微调。边界使用完整未来轨迹，不一定满足理想停止条件；一项任务下降1.95个百分点，留出场景种子不等于独立训练种子。

papers.title: ACWM-RM: A Reference-Free Reward Model from Complementary Mismatch Preferences
papers.summary_en: A reward model combines action-mismatch and video-mismatch preferences to judge visual quality and action following without reference videos at reward-computation time. It introduces AVM-Eval (67.2k pairs) and AVM-Pref (506.3k pairs). RL evidence is restricted to one 2B world model and AgiBotWorld, not robot task success. Physical consistency is not directly supervised and ratings rely on a VLM. Reference-free reward computation does not mean reference-free dataset construction; pairwise ranking is not a guarantee of physical validity.
papers.summary_zh: 结合动作错配和视频错配偏好，训练无需奖励计算时参考视频的模型，联合评价视觉质量与动作跟随；构建AVM-Eval（67.2k对）和AVM-Pref（506.3k对）。 RL证据限于一个2B世界模型与AgiBotWorld，不是机器人任务成功率。未直接监督物理一致性，评分依赖VLM；奖励计算无需参考不等于数据构建无需参考，成对排序也不保证物理正确。

papers.title: UniAction: Unified Action Conditioning for World Models
papers.summary_en: UniAction represents force, camera, hand and robot-pose actions as sparse semantic elements with continuous spatiotemporal coordinates, mapped into the video backbone’s native RoPE geometry. Cardinality-calibrated attention compensates for different action-token counts. These are video-generation action-following scores, not closed-loop robot success. Conditioning branches differ in trainable parameter counts. Joint training does not improve every metric: camera LPIPS is .4863 versus expert .4780. Four specified action forms do not establish arbitrary-action or unseen-embodiment generalization.
papers.summary_zh: 把力、相机、手部及机器人位姿动作表示为带语义身份与连续时空坐标的稀疏元素，映射到视频骨干原生RoPE几何；用基数校准attention补偿不同动作token数量。 这是视频生成动作跟随得分，不是闭环机器人成功率；不同条件分支可训练参数量不同。联合训练并非所有指标更好：相机LPIPS .4863，高于专家.4780。四种预设动作不证明任意动作或未见本体泛化。

papers.title: Ψ-0.6: Adaptive Streams of Thought in a Unified Vision-Language World Model
papers.summary_en: A unified token interface generates and interprets text, images, geometry and motion; adaptive streams of thought select intermediate representations. GRPO provides a proof of concept for choosing reasoning streams on visual question answering. The reported sim-to-real transfer concerns visual question answering over recorded robot videos, not robot deployment. Optical flow and tracks are proxy actions rather than actuator commands. Training-time positive/negative transfer among unified capabilities is not isolated; physical control remains future work.
papers.summary_zh: 统一token接口生成及理解文字、图像、几何和运动，通过自适应思维流选择中间表示；以GRPO在视觉问答上验证如何选择推理流。 这里的sim-to-real是已录机器人视频上的视觉问答，不是真机部署。光流和轨迹是代理动作而非执行器命令；未隔离统一能力训练时的正负迁移，物理控制仍属未来工作。

papers.title: Full-Weight VLA Fine-Tuning Without an fp32 Master Copy Silently Erases Most Updates
papers.summary_en: Audits update rounding when trainable matrices and AdamW state remain bf16 without fp32 master weights. One suite and shortened schedules; precision of optimizer moments is not separately ablated. SmolVLA scorer discrepancies restrict cross-paper comparisons. This does not show every bf16 computation or JAX training setup is affected.
papers.summary_zh: 审计可训练矩阵和AdamW状态保持bf16、无fp32主副本时的更新舍入。 仅一个任务集、缩短训练；未单独消融优化器矩精度。SmolVLA评测器差异限制跨论文比较；不能推断所有bf16计算或JAX训练均受影响。

papers.title: TTT in VLA Models: Exploring Training with Human Demonstrations
papers.summary_en: Integrates fast-weight TTT into InternVLA-A1 and pi0.5, documenting human-to-robot memory transfer and truncated gradient paths. Negative findings are limited to small cup-selection datasets and tested recipes, not a disproof of TTT. Trial counts are insufficiently reported. Autoregressive-state evaluation still uses recorded images, not closed-loop observations.
papers.summary_zh: 在InternVLA-A1和π0.5中加入fast-weight TTT，记录人类示范到机器人阶段的记忆传递及截断梯度路径。 负结果限于小规模选杯数据和所测配方，不是对TTT的普遍否定；试验次数报告不足。自回归状态评估仍使用录制图像，并非闭环观测。

papers.title: Coupling Execution Horizon and Sampling Depth in Flow-Matching VLA Policies
papers.summary_en: Jointly studies executed action horizon and flow-solver depth, testing when shallow sampling helps or harms. Long open-loop execution fails on moving targets; speedup is amortized inference cost, not guaranteed wall-clock task acceleration. The paper inconsistently describes simulation task totals and pi0.5 chunk configurations.
papers.summary_zh: 联合研究执行动作长度与flow求解步数，检验浅采样何时有效或有害。 长开环在移动目标上失效；加速指摊销推理成本，不保证任务墙钟加速。论文对仿真任务总数及π0.5动作块配置存在不一致描述。

papers.title: MAST-VLA: Skill-Conditioned Adaptation with Trajectory-Affordance Priors for Multi-Skill Robot Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Combines skill-conditioned LoRA experts with RGB-D trajectory-affordance heatmaps that bias action attention. MAST additionally receives depth, unlike RGB-only baselines; gains cannot isolate architecture alone. Instructions arrive per primitive, not as an autonomously decomposed long task. Geometry failures and execution drift remain.
papers.summary_zh: 将技能条件LoRA专家与RGB-D轨迹可供性热图结合，以热图偏置动作注意力。 MAST额外使用深度而基线仅RGB，不能将收益全归因于架构。指令逐原语下发，并非自主分解长任务；几何失效和执行漂移仍存在。

papers.title: If at First You Don’t Succeed, Backtrack: Lightweight Recovery for Frozen VLAs
papers.summary_en: Trains a small failure head on frozen-policy rollouts and reverses achieved arm motion before retrying. Simulation only; pooled results include configuration-selection seeds. Held-out pi0.5 uplift is 0.70 points. Reversal does not restore objects or guarantee safety, and the head requires labeled rollouts.
papers.summary_zh: 用冻结策略rollout训练小型失败头，触发后回放实际已完成机械臂运动的逆序，再交回原策略重试。 仅仿真；汇总结果包含选参种子，留出种子π0.5收益为0.70个百分点。回退不恢复物体或保证安全，失败头仍需标注rollout训练。

papers.title: WorldMirror: Agentic Real-to-Sim Generation of Interactive Worlds from In-the-Wild Robot Demonstrations
papers.summary_en: Constructs executable world programs from robot demonstrations, with a coding agent using replay feedback to repair scene geometry, assets, and physical interactions. Results concern recorded-trajectory replay in reconstructed simulation, not new-policy real-robot success or sim-to-real learning. Spatial metrics do not uniformly beat Astra, and component ablations cover one task, offering little evidence of a memory benefit.
papers.summary_zh: 把真实演示的数字孪生构建写成可执行世界程序，由编码代理诊断回放失败并定向修复场景、资产与物理交互。 这是已录轨迹在重建仿真中的回放，不是真机新策略成功率或sim2real收益。空间指标并非全面胜过Astra；组件消融限于一个任务，尚不能归因长期记忆收益。

papers.title: EgoForesight: Effectively Scaling Policy Learning with Noisy Egocentric Actions
papers.summary_en: Combines reliability-dependent corruption and loss weighting with joint vision–action flow and privileged-future EMA distillation to learn from noisy human action labels. External RoboCasa baselines use published results with different pretraining and budgets. The real π0.5 baseline replaces input/output projections for 58 DoF, confounding attribution. Action labels remain required, and source weighting does not correct systematic retargeting bias.
papers.summary_zh: 以来源可靠性调节噪声与损失权重，将联合视觉-动作流与可见干净未来的EMA教师蒸馏结合，利用带噪人类动作标签。 外部RoboCasa基线取自发表结果、预训练和预算不同。π0.5真机对照重置输入输出层以适配58DoF，不能将差距纯归因方法；仍需动作标注，来源加权不能纠正系统性重定向偏差。

papers.title: DynaSlots: Slot-Centric 3D Dynamics Pretraining for Robot Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Learns temporally aligned soft slots, slot-level latent actions, and proximity–motion relations from point-cloud sequences, supplying dynamics-aware 3D representations to a diffusion policy. Simulation baselines are inherited from AFRO, and each seed selects its best evaluated checkpoint rather than an independent final test. Real error bars reflect layout variability, not training seeds; one embodiment and one task underpin the robustness tests.
papers.summary_zh: 从点云序列自监督学习时序一致的软槽位、槽位级潜在动作及邻近-运动关系，再为扩散策略提供3D动力学表征。 仿真基线沿用AFRO论文结果，各种子选最好评估检查点，非独立最终测试。真机误差条是布局间标准差，不是训练种子方差；只一个本体且杂物/新物体仅一个任务。

papers.title: Predictive Long-Horizon Progress Modeling with Action-Aware Quantification
papers.summary_en: NimCritic couples predictive video learning with separate progress/completion outputs, perturbed progress history, and cross-modal alignment. LOOM contains 300 cross-embodiment trajectories and 19,618 human-calibrated frames. These are offline evaluator metrics, not robot task-success rates. Multi-subtask evaluation relies on offline VLM segmentation, not demonstrated real-time judging. Training uses 800+ hours and 48 accelerators; no closed-loop policy improvement from its reward is established.
papers.summary_zh: NimCritic以视频预测训练约束进度/完成度双输出，结合历史进度扰动与跨模态对齐；LOOM评测包含300条跨本体轨迹、19,618个人工校准帧。 上述是离线评价，不是机器人任务成功率。多子任务依赖离线VLM分段，非直接证明在线实时裁判可用；训练800余小时、48加速器，未报告用奖励后训练策略的闭环收益。

papers.title: Do VLAs Know They Will Fail? Interpretable Success and Failure Patterns in Physical AI Systems
papers.summary_en: Uses sparse autoencoder features of OpenVLA activations for failure prediction and VLM-generated behavioral interpretations, with branching rollouts estimating a point of no return. Simulation and one policy only. Unsupervised SAE fitting uses all 500 trajectories; supervised predictors use held-out splits. Four branches per probe give coarse, remaining-budget-dependent recoverability. Outcome associations are not causal failure mechanisms or validated safety interventions.
papers.summary_zh: 用稀疏自编码器分解OpenVLA内部激活，预测失败并由外部VLM解释与结果相关的行为；通过分支重试估计不可恢复时间点。 仅仿真、单模型；SAE无监督训练使用全部500轨迹，监督预测器才留出。每点4次分支估计粗糙且受剩余预算影响；相关特征并非因果机制或已验证安全干预。

papers.title: See What I Need, Dream What I Want: A Navigation Foundation Model on a Self-Constructed Representation Space
papers.summary_en: RepresentNav constructs policy-oriented representations from multiple layers of frozen vision backbones, then learns a JEPA-style latent future prediction before waypoint generation. External baselines are taken from their papers with differing observation settings. Physical navigation demonstrations do not establish manipulation transfer; dexterous and whole-body control remain untested.
papers.summary_zh: RepresentNav从多个冻结视觉骨干的多层特征构造策略导向表征，在同空间以JEPA训练预测未来的潜在推理，再生成路点。 外部基线来自原论文且观测设置不全相同。真机导航演示不能证明操作迁移；作者明确尚未验证操作、灵巧手或全身控制。

papers.title: PrefO2O: Zero-Shot Preference-Based Reinforcement Learning via Offline-to-Online Latent Preference Transfer
papers.summary_en: Transfers a jointly learned latent preference space and reward prior from labeled source tasks, then generates confidence-weighted optimal-transport pseudo-preferences for online target-task RL without target human labels. Zero-shot refers to target human feedback, not zero target interaction or training. Real trials are small; transfer assumes related preference dimensions. PEARL is modified for online learning and dimension mismatch; PrefFew receives limited source data and 100 target labels.
papers.summary_zh: 联合学习潜在偏好空间和奖励先验，通过置信度加权最优传输生成目标任务伪偏好，在不新增目标任务人工标签下在线强化学习。 零样本指无需目标人工反馈，并非无目标交互或训练。真机样本少，要求源目标共享偏好维度；PEARL做了在线化与维度补齐，PrefFew处于有限源数据设置并使用100个目标标签。

papers.title: SEVI: Safe Evidential Real-World Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary_en: Adds an evidential safety critic that gates task actions using predicted violation risk and epistemic uncertainty, invoking a shared offline-trained recovery policy during online RL. Only one hardware task and two simulated tasks; no formal zero-violation guarantee. Hardware learning uses 50 successful prior demonstrations, 200 recovery demonstrations and validation-based thresholds. Final success and cumulative training incidents have different denominators.
papers.summary_zh: 证据式安全critic同时估计违规风险与认知不确定性，在在线RL中筛查动作并调用离线训练的恢复策略。 仅1项真机、2项仿真任务，无零违规形式保证。真机使用50条成功先验示范、200条恢复示范及验证集阈值；最终成功率与累计训练事件口径不同。

papers.title: DiscoDemo: Discovering Efficient and Diverse Robot Demonstrations for Imitation Learning
papers.summary_en: Uses privileged, latent-conditioned RL with a reverse curriculum and success-gated diversity to generate filtered demonstration datasets, then trains a visuomotor π0.5 policy rather than deploying the RL generator. Requires accurate simulation, privileged states, reset access and task success signals. Hardware evidence covers four simple tabletop tasks with modest transfer gaps and only one training seed; excessive diversity can hurt competence.
papers.summary_zh: 用特权状态、潜变量条件RL、逆向课程和成功门控多样性生成过滤后的示范，再训练视觉π0.5，部署的不是RL生成器。 依赖准确仿真、特权状态、状态重置和成功信号。真机仅4个简单桌面任务、较小迁移差距及1个训练种子；过大多样性会损害任务能力。

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Close-Fitting Wearable Insertion
papers.summary_en: Formulates close-fitting bracelet dressing as geometric insertion and combines a finger-wise soft insertion gate with a staged curriculum, transferring a compact geometric observation interface to a bimanual robot. Bracelet is pregrasped and the mannequin stationary; deployment is slowed by about half. No force-aware observation or objective, so finger deflection is not a safety measurement. Large combined pose shifts reduce simulated success to 26/50.
papers.summary_zh: 把紧贴手部的手环穿戴建模为几何插入，结合逐指软插入门控和分阶段课程，通过紧凑几何观测接口迁移到双臂机器人。 手环预抓持、假手静止，真机约减半速度。没有力感知观测/目标，手指偏转不是安全指标；大幅组合姿态扰动使仿真成功降至26/50。

papers.title: $R^2E:$ A Role-driven Reward Evolutionary Framework for Automated Reward Function Design
papers.summary_en: Coordinates Explorer, Guardian and Evolver LLM roles around a five-entry elite reward pool, using dynamic candidate allocation for iterative reward-program search. Only simulation and task-specific reward search, not cross-task robot skill accumulation. Elite-pool monotonicity concerns retained search scores, not guaranteed future policy improvement. RL training dominates compute; baseline search/token budgets should not be assumed identical merely because the backbone matches.
papers.summary_zh: 以5项精英奖励池协调Explorer、Guardian、Evolver三类LLM角色，动态分配候选预算进行奖励程序迭代搜索。 仅仿真与任务内奖励搜索，不是跨任务机器人技能积累。精英池单调性针对保留搜索分数，不保证未来策略持续提升；RL训练主导成本，同骨干不等于所有基线搜索/token预算相同。

papers.title: Retiming Robot Demonstrations with a Learned Speed Prior
papers.summary_en: Learns a transferable distribution over demonstration speed, retimes trajectories to faster observed paces, and pairs a tempo-predicting VLA with constraint-aware real-time trajectory execution. Needs offline policy training and a specialized execution controller, not a drop-in inference-speed tweak. The prior cannot exceed demonstrated paces. Some success gains can arise from timeouts; the authors use matched speed to control this. SAIL numbers use a different robot and policy.
papers.summary_zh: 学习可迁移的示范速度分布，用已观测更快节奏重定时轨迹，并把预测节奏的VLA与约束感知实时轨迹执行层结合。 需要离线策略训练和专门执行控制器，不是直接加速推理的开关。速度先验不能超出已有示范节奏；超时会影响成功率，因此须看同速对照。SAIL对比采用不同机器人与策略。

papers.title: Regularised RL improves sim-to-real transfer
papers.summary_en: Extends soft mellowmax to continuous-control actor–critic with a slowly updated reference policy and tests whether regularization improves sim-to-real robustness beyond nominal training return. Return is not success rate. Domain randomization remains necessary, and temperatures vary by task. PPO/FastTD3 are excluded from ANYmal perturbation deployment after failing a prespecified simulation safety check, so those cells are missing, not observed hardware failures. MuJoCo tuning budgets are unequal.
papers.summary_zh: 用缓慢更新参考策略把soft mellowmax扩展到连续控制actor–critic，检验正则化是否改善超越名义训练回报的sim2real鲁棒性。 回报不是成功率；仍需要域随机化，温度参数随任务变化。PPO/FastTD3因未通过预设仿真安全筛查而没有ANYmal扰动部署，空白不能算实测真机失败；MuJoCo调参预算不完全相等。

papers.title: RobustRLlib: A Unified Library and Benchmark for Robust Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
papers.summary_en: Unifies 17 robust/safe RL algorithms and six standard references, with reusable interfaces and individual/compound deployment shifts including latency and semantics. Not every algorithm runs every task. Methods retain native budgets, and pooled-family comparisons mix backbone strength with robustness mechanisms. The π0.5 study uses one fine-tuned model and offline joint-space demonstration tracking, not closed-loop VLA task success or real-robot validation.
papers.summary_zh: 统一17种鲁棒/安全RL算法及6种标准对照，提供可复用接口及含延迟、语义的单因素/组合部署扰动。 并非每算法运行每任务；保留各自原生预算，算法族混合均值会混入基础学习器强弱。π0.5实验仅单个微调模型的离线关节示范轨迹跟踪，不是闭环VLA成功率或真机验证。

papers.title: DexPort: A Hand-Held Skill Interface for Dexterous Hand Data Collection
papers.summary_en: A portable interface uses the deployed dexterous hand, parameterized grasp skills and a learned rotation skill to collect wrist motion and native joint commands; the imitation policy receives no skill labels. Small evaluation samples; screwdriver rotation uses a separate speed metric, not the three-task success mean. Demonstration quantity and scene diversity change together. Collection skills are not an autonomously growing skill library.
papers.summary_zh: 便携接口使用部署时的灵巧手，以参数化抓取和学习式旋转技能采集腕部运动及原生关节指令；模仿策略不接收技能标签。 评估样本少；螺丝刀旋转单独用速度指标，不计入三任务成功率均值。数据量与场景多样性同时变化；采集技能并非自主增长的技能库。

papers.title: ViT-H: Generative Video-To-Humanoid Control with Motion Tracking Feedback
papers.summary_en: Generates G1 reference motion directly from monocular video and post-trains the diffusion generator with tracker-derived preference pairs; an autoregressive variant enables video teleoperation. These percentages measure simulated reference tracking, not real-world task completion. Fine hand poses are not modeled; real deployment evidence is qualitative, and online initialization takes about ten seconds.
papers.summary_zh: 从单目视频直接生成G1参考运动，以跟踪器反馈构造偏好对后训练扩散生成器；自回归版本支持视频遥操作。 百分比为仿真参考运动跟踪率，不是真机任务完成率。未建模精细手部姿态；真机证据以定性示范为主，在线初始化约10秒。

papers.title: WAM-TTT: Steering World-Action Models by Watching Human Play at Test Time
papers.summary_en: Human videos write fast-weight memory in a world-action model; paired human–robot meta-training teaches the video-to-action transfer interface. These are interface variants inside one WAM, not faithful evaluations of the complete original systems. The extra interface test covers one task; FastWAM evidence is qualitative eight-frame prediction over 3.2 s, not closed-loop control transfer. Some alternatives rely on pretrained skill latents absent from meta-training-only insertion.
papers.summary_zh: 通过人类视频写入世界动作模型的快权重记忆，配对人类—机器人元训练学习视频到动作的迁移接口。 对照是同一WAM内的接口变体，而非原系统完整复现；新增接口实验仅一个任务。FastWAM证据是3.2秒、8帧预测的定性展示，不是闭环控制迁移；部分对照依赖预训练技能潜变量，元训练阶段直接插入并不具备该先验。

papers.title: GaP: A Graph-as-Policy Multi-Agent Self-Learning Harness For Variational Automation Tasks
papers.summary_en: GaP composes typed robot skill graphs and improves their structure, parameters and throughput through simulation rehearsal before deployment. New throughput evidence is simulation, not a new real-robot productivity result. The paper explicitly says CaP-X is not a fair standalone comparison because available environment geometry differs. MORSL equalizes selected perception/grasp components, not all motion primitives, inference budgets or system choices. The tasks are mostly quasi-static.
papers.summary_zh: GaP组合带类型的机器人技能图，在部署前通过仿真排练优化图结构、参数和吞吐。 新增吞吐证据来自仿真，并非新增真机生产率结果。论文明确承认CaP-X对照因已知环境几何信息不同而不公平；MORSL仅对齐部分感知/抓取组件，并未对齐所有运动原语、推理预算和系统选项。任务仍以准静态为主。

papers.title: Do Robotic World Models Really Follow Actions? Diagnosing and Aligning Action-Conditioned Generation for Policy Learning
papers.summary_en: WorldEcho evaluates off-expert action following using visual screening and end-effector trajectory alignment; WorldSync combines broader action data with dynamics grounding and intervention-effect supervision. The small headline gated-error difference is a point estimate, not established significance. Visual screening does not guarantee integrity; its human checks use only 15 clips per dimension. Video metrics use reconstructed references and separate generation batches. Pretraining corpora and baseline histories differ; the expanded-data advantage is not a controlled data-efficiency claim.
papers.summary_zh: WorldEcho以视觉筛查与末端轨迹对齐评估非专家动作跟随；WorldSync结合更广动作数据、动力学表征约束及干预效果监督。 主表微小门控差距仅为点估计，未证明显著；视觉筛查不保证完整性，人工核验每维仅15段。视频指标使用重建参考和独立生成批次；不同预训练语料及基线历史不能支持受控数据效率结论。

papers.title: Metro-WM: Long-Horizon Latent Planning with Realisable Sub-Goals
papers.summary_en: A nonparametric macro planner retrieves observed states from an offline trajectory graph and uses shortest-path subgoals with repeated graph re-entry. All added tests are simulated. Metro uses a fixed rather than shrinking horizon and tunes horizon/subgoal distance plus executed-block count on separate tuning tasks; baselines use released configurations. Retrieved states are real, but this does not certify every connecting transition. Diverse layouts absent from the corpus may break stitching.
papers.summary_zh: 非参数宏观规划器从离线轨迹图检索真实观测状态，以最短路径子目标和动态重新入图支持长程控制。 新增实验均为仿真。Metro采用固定而非递减时域，并在独立调参任务上选择时域、子目标距离和执行块数；基线使用公开配置。检索状态真实不等于每条连接转移都可保证；语料中罕见的多样布局可能破坏轨迹拼接。

papers.title: Are Frontier VLM Agents Ready to Be Robot Generalists? An Empirical Study with the Embodied Agent Arena
papers.summary_en: A unified arena separates geometric prediction, affordance grounding, intermediate subgoals and native complete-task success across 1,000 cases. The union is retrospective coverage, not a deployed ensemble success rate. Source interfaces and budgets are retained rather than identical across all tasks; some supplementary episodes and missing records are explicitly separate. Error-free code and low latency must not be equated with physical task completion; this is benchmark evidence rather than new real-robot validation.
papers.summary_zh: 统一评测在1,000个案例中区分几何预测、可供性定位、中间子目标和原生完整任务成功。 并集是事后覆盖，并非已部署集成策略成功率。各源任务保留接口与预算而非全部一致，部分补充回合及缺失记录单独处理。无代码错误和低延迟不能等同物理任务完成；本次是基准证据而非新增真机验证。

papers.title: Semantic Anchoring for Robotic Action Representations
papers.summary_en: An auxiliary alignment objective preserves task-level semantics during VLA fine-tuning through shared/private representations anchored to a frozen manipulation-text encoder; auxiliary modules are removed at inference. Correlations do not establish semantic erosion as the sole cause of OOD failure. Architectures use different official fine-tuning recipes. The fixed semantic encoder bounds the method, shared/private factors are not identifiable, and this is downstream fine-tuning rather than continual deployment adaptation.
papers.summary_zh: 以冻结的操作文本编码器为锚，通过共享/私有表征的辅助对齐目标保留VLA微调中的任务语义，推理时移除辅助模块。 相关性不能证明语义侵蚀是分布外失败的唯一原因；各架构沿用不同官方微调方案。冻结语义编码器限制性能，共享/私有因子无可识别性保证；属于下游微调而非部署中的持续适配。

papers.title: RAPAC-DP: Response-Aligned Pending-Action Compensation for Diffusion Policies under Delayed Execution
papers.summary_en: A frozen diffusion/flow policy gains a pending-action encoder and LoRA compensation that aligns each output chunk to its scheduled execution time, trained using delay-conditioned samples from delay-free demonstrations. Only one checkpoint per method/task is tested, so confidence intervals describe trial variation rather than training-seed robustness. Fixed conveyor speed/starts and injected discrete delays limit claims about arbitrary network jitter. At low delay it trails RTC on dynamic grasping (73.3% versus 76.7%); the method requires training an adapter.
papers.summary_zh: 在冻结扩散/流策略上加入待执行动作编码器和LoRA补偿，将动作块对齐计划交接时间，仅用无延迟示范构造延迟条件训练样本。 每方法/任务仅一个检查点，置信区间反映试验抽样而非训练种子鲁棒性。固定传送带速度/起点和离散注入延迟限制其对任意网络抖动的结论；低延迟动态抓取73.3%低于RTC76.7%。需要训练适配器，不是免训练修复。

papers.title: Probing Collision Grounding in Vision-Language Models for Safe Human-Robot Collaboration
papers.summary_en: TouchSafeBench evaluates current collision recognition and early warning in simulated human–robot co-presence, separating robot–scene and human-contact risks. The real recordings contain no physical contact and use a human head-mounted camera; labels are binary proximity at a 1 m threshold, not actual collision safety. False-alarm estimates use only 12 hard negatives. Prompt tests repeat one model/condition; one expert saw viewpoint conditions in fixed order. No closed-loop safety intervention is validated.
papers.summary_zh: TouchSafeBench在仿真人机共处中评估当前碰撞识别和提前预警，区分机器人—场景与人类接触风险。 真实录像无物理接触，且为人头戴相机；标签是1米阈值的二元接近状态，并非实际碰撞安全。误报统计只有12个难负例。提示测试仅一个模型/条件，单专家按固定顺序看不同视角；未验证闭环安全干预。

papers.title: RMMBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Robotic Mobile Manipulation
papers.summary_en: A MuJoCo mobile-manipulation benchmark separates task success, subgoal progress, spatial grounding and repeated-action recovery through a fixed skill interface. Simulation only, three episodes per task, discretized grid navigation and a fixed skill library. Grasp candidates include expert-verified ground-truth fallback annotations as well as GraspNet outputs; the evaluation does not demonstrate end-to-end low-level control or autonomous skill expansion. Execution efficiency is computed only on successful trajectories and reflection scores only on episodes containing repeated-action loops.
papers.summary_zh: 基于MuJoCo的移动操作基准，通过固定技能接口分别评估任务成功、子目标进展、空间定位及重复动作后的恢复。 仅仿真、每任务3回合、离散网格导航及固定技能库；抓取候选同时包含GraspNet输出与专家核验的真值兜底标注，不能证明端到端低层控制或自主技能扩展。执行效率仅在成功轨迹统计，反思分数仅在含重复动作循环的回合统计。

papers.title: PartialBiGrasp: Inferring Hidden Local Geometry for Bimanual Grasping from Partial Views
papers.summary_en: Occupancy-conditioned global and local geometry representations generate and refine bimanual grasp pairs from a segmented single-view RGB-D observation. Hardware trials evaluate only this method, without matched real-robot baseline rates, and success means lifting rather than completing a downstream manipulation task. Candidates are filtered for collision-free kinematic reachability. The separate real-world RGB-D dataset table uses digital-twin simulation metrics, not hardware success; its 81.54% GS must not be confused with the 39/54 lift rate.
papers.summary_zh: 利用占据条件的全局与局部几何表征，从带分割的单视角RGB-D观测生成并细化双臂抓取对。 真机只评本方法，无同协议真机基线成功率；成功定义为抬起，不是完成后续操作。候选先经无碰撞及运动学可达过滤。另一个真实RGB-D数据集表使用数字孪生仿真指标，并非真机成功率，81.54%的GS不可与39/54抬起率混淆。

papers.title: ContactBench 1.0: A Benchmark for Everyday Contact-Rich Robotic Manipulation
papers.summary_en: A benchmark of eight contact-rich skill categories, 36 reference tasks and over 40 printable assets with corresponding simulation components; six tasks evaluate vision-only and visual-tactile learned policies. The four systems differ in pretraining, observation histories and tactile interfaces, so this is not a perfectly isolated tactile-modality ablation. Only six of 36 tasks receive learned-policy evaluation. Velcro stabilization enables one-arm tasks that could otherwise require another arm. Rigid/articulated printed assets do not cover deformable contact; negative tactile results apply to the tested policies and sensors, not touch in general.
